9043-may-day-with-the-muses.title: Mayday With The Muses.
9043-may-day-with-the-muses.creator: Robert Bloomfield
9043-may-day-with-the-muses.description: A book by Robert Bloomfield. from any one; a man has a right to do what he likes with his own estate. The characters I have introduced as candidates may not come off so easily; a cluster of poets is not likely to be found in one village, and the following lines, written by my good friend T. of Hampstead, are not only true, but beautifully true, and I cannot omit them. WRITTEN IN THE ISLE OF THANET,  August, 1790.

arxiv-2110-01124.title: Un-symmetric photon subtraction: a method for generating high photon number states and their relevance to loss estimation at ultimate quantum limit
arxiv-2110-01124.creator: N. Samantaray, J. C. F. Matthews, J. G. Rarity
arxiv-2110-01124.description: Abstract We have studied theoretical un-symmetric multi-photon subtracted twin beam state and demonstrated a method for generating states that resembles to high photon number states with the increase in the number of subtracted photons through Wigner distribution function, which can be reconstructed experimentally by Homodyne measurement.

arxiv-2110-08840.title: Online Facility Location with Predictions
arxiv-2110-08840.creator: Shaofeng H.-C. Jiang, Erzhi Liu, You Lyu, Zhihao Gavin Tang, Yubo Zhang
arxiv-2110-08840.description: Abstract We provide nearly optimal algorithms for online facility location (OFL) with predictions. In OFL, n n demand points arrive in order and the algorithm must irrevocably assign each demand point to an open facility upon its arrival. The objective is to minimize the total connection costs from demand points to assigned facilities plus the facility opening cost.

arxiv-2112-08738.title: Linear Regression, Covariate Selection and the Failure of Modelling.
arxiv-2112-08738.creator: Laurie Davies
arxiv-2112-08738.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Laurie Davies. It is argued that all model based approaches to the selection of covariates in linear regression have failed. This applies to frequentist approaches based on P-values and to Bayesian approaches although for different reasons. In the first part of the paper 13 model based procedures are compared to the model-free Gaussian covariate procedure in terms of the covariates selected and the time required. The comparison is based on seven data sets and three simulations.

arxiv-2209-14804.title: Minimum Link Fencing
arxiv-2209-14804.creator: Sujoy Bhore, Fabian Klute, Maarten Löffler, Martin Nöllenburg, Soeren Terziadis, Anaïs Villedieu
arxiv-2209-14804.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sujoy Bhore, Fabian Klute, Maarten Löffler, Martin Nöllenburg, Soeren Terziadis, Anaïs Villedieu. We study a variant of the geometric multicut problem, where we are given a set 𝒫 \mathcal{P} of colored and pairwise interior-disjoint polygons in the plane.

arxiv-2410-03255.title: Towards a Benchmark for Large Language Models for Business Process Management Tasks
arxiv-2410-03255.creator: Kiran Busch, Henrik Leopold
arxiv-2410-03255.description: Abstract An increasing number of organizations are deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) for a wide range of tasks. Despite their general utility, LLMs are prone to errors, ranging from inaccuracies to hallucinations. To objectively assess the capabilities of existing LLMs, performance benchmarks are conducted. However, these benchmarks often do not translate to more specific real-world tasks.

arxiv-2502-16741.title: The visibility of the Ōtautahi-Oxford interstellar object population model in LSST
arxiv-2502-16741.creator: Rosemary C. Dorsey, Matthew J. Hopkins, Michele T. Bannister, Samantha M. Lawler, Chris Lintott, Alex H. Parker, John C. Forbes
arxiv-2502-16741.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rosemary C. Dorsey, Matthew J. Hopkins, Michele T. Bannister, Samantha M. Lawler, Chris Lintott, Alex H. Parker, John C. Forbes. With a new probabilistic technique for sampling interstellar object (ISO) orbits with high efficiency, we assess the observability of ISOs under a realistic cadence for the upcoming Vera Rubin Observatory’s Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST).

pmc-10572196.title: Storage Stability of Meat Analogs Supplemented with Vegetable Oils
pmc-10572196.creator: Youngjae Cho, Junhwan Bae, Jiseon Lee, Mi-Jung Choi, Begoña Panea
pmc-10572196.description: The addition of various oils to meat analog has been an important topic to improving its juiciness and tenderness. However, this causes a concern about oil leaching from the meat analog during long-term storage. Here, we aimed to assess the storage stability of vegetable-oil-supplemented meat analogs and analyze the effects of temperature and storage period on their physiochemical characteristics.

pmc-10626123.title: Impact of combining Lenvatinib with Transarterial chemoembolization for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-10626123.creator: Jianwu Long, Longfei Liu, Xuefeng Yang, Xianzhou Lu, Lei Qin
pmc-10626123.description: Objectives:To investigate the impact of combining lenvatinib with transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).Methods:This was a retrospective observational study which reviewed the medical records of 103 unresectable HCC patients from January 2017 to June 2020 in The First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University.

pmc-11406113.title: Prescribing Trend of Antibiotics Among the Patients Admitted in Intensive Medical Care Unit: A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-11406113.creator: Jegatheeswaran M, Mohammad Nezamuddin Khan, Ajith R, Sarumathy Sundararajan, Nanda Kumar R
pmc-11406113.description: Background: Intensive medical care units (IMCUs) usually admit patients who are in critical medical need and require the utmost attention of healthcare professionals, along with the best treatment options available. These patients are prone to infections and require various antibiotics for the treatment.

pmc-11486315.title: Molecular identification and biological characterization of Eimeria columbarum from domestic pigeons (Columba livia domestica) in Guangdong, China
pmc-11486315.creator: Xi He, Xue-Mei Fang, Yu-Tong Qiao, Jia-Li Su, Sheng-Qiu Tang, Ya-Biao Weng, Rui-Qing Lin
pmc-11486315.description: Pigeon coccidiosis caused by Eimeria spp. is an important veterinary disease with a significant economic impact on the pigeon industry. Preventive measures for Eimeria columbarum in pigeons have been hampered by the lack of extensive genetic, morphological, and biological data on the oocysts. In this study, we examined the prevalence and identity of Eimeria spp.

pmc-12530611.title: From ideal to practical: Heterogeneity of student-generated variant lists highlights hidden reproducibility gaps
pmc-12530611.creator: Rumeysa Aslıhan Ertürk, Abdullah Asım Emül, Büşra Nur Darendeli-Kiraz, Fatma Zehra Sarı, Mehmet Arif Ergün, Mehmet Baysan
pmc-12530611.description: Next-generation sequencing (NGS) technologies offer detailed and inexpensive identification of the genetic structure of living organisms. The massive data volume necessitates the utilization of advanced computational resources for analyses. However, the rapid accumulation of data and the urgent need for analysis tools have caused the development of imperfect software solutions.

pmc-12587464.title: The Preparation of Dentin Matrix-Polycaprolactone Drug Carrier Scaffold and Its Application in Promoting Bone Formation
pmc-12587464.creator: Yiqun Dong, Nenghui Sun, Hongyang Zhu
pmc-12587464.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and objectiveThe bioactivity of natural plant extracts, such as Chinese herbal medicines, is often limited by their poor water solubility. Therefore, selecting an appropriate drug carrier is crucial for exerting the pharmacological effects of these medicines.

pmc-12711094.title: Toward an integrated model of dietary behavior: Social determinants and adherence to the mediterranean diet
pmc-12711094.creator: Francesca Romana Lenzi, Ciro Clemente De Falco, Michela Cavagnuolo, Vincenzo Esposito, Ferdinando Iazzetta, António Raposo, António Raposo, António Raposo
pmc-12711094.description: BackgroundAdherence to the Mediterranean diet is widely recognized as a protective factor for health, yet its determinants remain complex and multidimensional. This study investigates the social, economic, cultural, familial, and perceptual factors associated with adherence to the Mediterranean diet within the Italian population.

pmc-13314715.title: Serum Leptin Exacerbates Osteoarthritis by Promoting Subchondral Bone H‐Type Vessel Angiogenesis via Activation of the PI3K/AKT Pathway
pmc-13314715.creator: Ruifu Li, Zhao Xi, Shitong Luo, Jun Qin, Tao Liu, Jian Zhang
pmc-13314715.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Osteoarthritis (OA) is a common degenerative joint disease closely associated with obesity. Adipokines secreted by adipose tissue play critical roles in disease progression. This study focuses on the adipokine leptin and investigates its relationship with knee osteoarthritis. Analysis of subchondral bone tissue from OA patients revealed decreased leptin receptor expression, enhanced osteogenic activity, and a significant increase in H‐type vessel number. Concurrently, serum leptin levels were markedly elevated in OA patients.
